name: EffectForce
author: Devko
summary: A live looper and performance mixer in one insert slot: record bars on MPC's grid, then roll, slow, reverse and layer them, and crossfade two scenes from 64 one-tap effects. Plus a ten-module effect rack with macros, LFOs and a mod matrix, 62 presets and a 14-page touchscreen skin with Q-Links.
